主要内容: Royal Bank of Canada has adopted a revised Code of Conduct in 2018, incorporating amendments related to sales practices and tax law compliance. The Code of Conduct applies to all employees, contract workers, and board members, including key officers. The bank maintains a robust economic sanctions compliance program and has been in compliance with relevant legislation throughout fiscal 2018. It holds non-U.S. dollar denominated accounts for the Embassy of the Islamic Republic of Iran in Canada, which are frozen by an Ontario court order due to civil litigation. These accounts generated less than $3,000 in gross revenue and less than $3,000 in net income during fiscal 2018.
